builds.name: Reference: Ranked bot core
builds.goal: Reference for Tristana: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ bot players use most (29,159 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 58.8% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A ranged attack carry who rapidly stacks a bomb for burst and jump resets, with growing range supporting later safety. Jumping aggressively depends on actually completing the bomb or obtaining a takedown. The current adc provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Yun Tal Wildarrows → Infinity Edge → Navori Flickerblade. Lethal Tempo keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Berserker's Greaves, Lord Dominik's Regards, Bloodthirster.
builds.summary: The proven bot baseline: Yun Tal Wildarrows → Infinity Edge → Navori Flickerblade, with Lethal Tempo.
testPlan: Play it in bot as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Yun Tal Wildarrows → Infinity Edge → Navori Flickerblade) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 58.8% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Yun Tal Wildarrows → Infinity Edge → Navori Flickerblade.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Tristana's Attacks that kill enemies deal [45 / 60 / 75 / 90 / 105 + (0.25) × AP] magic damage to surrounding enemies.

Active: Tristana attaches a bomb to an enemy or turret that deals [(60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.5) × AP) × ((1 + ((0.4) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] physical damage to surrounding enemies after [4] seconds. The damage is increased by [25]% each time Tristana hits an Attack or Ability (max 4 stacks).

At [4] stacks, the bomb explodes immediately (max [((60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.5) × AP) × ((1 + ((0.4) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))) × ((1 + (0.25) × (4)))] physical damage).
Tristana's Attack Range and the range of {{Spell_TristanaE_Name}} and {{Spell_TristanaR_Name}} are increased by [characterLevelInterpolation(0 → 150; raw flags preserved)].

Tristana fires a massive cannonball, dealing [225 / 275 / 325 + (0.7) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1) × AP] magic damage to the target, Knocking Back and Stunning them and surrounding enemies for [0.4 / 0.55 / 0.7] seconds.
Tristana goes full-auto, gaining [(0.6 / 0.75 / 0.9 / 1.05 / 1.2) × 100]% Attack Speed for [7] seconds.

Tristana launches herself, dealing [70 / 105 / 140 / 175 / 210 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.5) × AP] magic damage and Slowing by [40]% for [2] seconds upon landing.

Champion takedowns and max stack {{Spell_TristanaE_Name}} detonations on champions refresh this Ability's Cooldown.

builds.name: AP bomb jump assassin
builds.summary: Test ap bomb jump assassin against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test ap bomb jump assassin against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Explosive Charge has 0.5 AP physical scaling before its four-hit doubling; Buster Shot has 1.0 AP magic scaling and W adds 0.5 AP magic damage. Nashor and Lich Bane support stacking E with real attacks before a max-stack detonation refreshes W.
testPlan: Required state: Apply E, land four valid hits and reserve R knockback direction.
Measure E physical damage separately from W/R magic burst.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Physical E resists magic penetration and failure to detonate strands W.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: AP does not turn E magic and turret bomb detonation does not grant the champion-only W reset.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Lich Bane, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Banshee's Veil, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Physical matchup
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Tristana: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A ranged attack carry who rapidly stacks a bomb for burst and jump resets, with growing range supporting later safety. Jumping aggressively depends on actually completing the bomb or obtaining a takedown. Measure four bomb stacks, attack range by level and actual jump reset. AP burst is a risky bomb/ability experiment, not guaranteed crit-carry DPS. Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
builds.summary: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Tristana: Measure four bomb stacks, attack range by level and actual jump reset. AP burst is a risky bomb/ability experiment, not guaranteed crit-carry DPS.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then matchup armor) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Tristana fires her weapon rapidly, increasing her Attack Speed for a short time. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Randuin is conditional on the enemy attack/crit profile; it costs an offensive slot.
The route fails Tristana's stated kit question: Measure four bomb stacks, attack range by level and actual jump reset. AP burst is a risky bomb/ability experiment, not guaranteed crit-carry DPS.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Randuin is conditional on the enemy attack/crit profile; it costs an offensive slot.
Full cost 16,100 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then matchup armor. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Randuin's Omen, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Health bomb reset fighter
builds.summary: Test health bomb reset fighter against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test health bomb reset fighter against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Rapid Fire grants up to 120% attack speed for seven seconds; Titanic and Bloodmail trade some conventional crit DPS for health and physical attacks while E stacks. Hexplate supports attacks after R and Essence Reaver supplies physical Spellblade plus mana; partial crit still improves E's documented multiplier.
testPlan: Required state: Connect E-stack attacks and choose R timing without knocking the target out early.
Compare time to four E stacks and health after a W-in trade.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Low damage prevents max-stack detonation and reset before retaliation.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Ability hits can stack E, but item splash is not assumed to be four independent bomb stacks.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
